widget.themeManual: Current: {theme} (manual) | Click to switch, double-click to follow system
widget.themeAuto: Current: Follow system ({theme}) | Click to switch manually

hints.language: Interface language. Follows the system by default.
hints.autoLaunch: Start DeskPulse automatically when you sign in
hints.preset: Accent color and system name color
hints.customAccent: Overrides the preset accent (pick a color or reset it)
hints.alertThreshold: CPU / memory / GPU values turn red above this level
hints.glass: Panel background transparency and blur style
hints.panelOpacity: Applies to the Off / Frosted modes only
hints.panelOpacityDisabled: Not available in Liquid mode (preserves refraction)
hints.displayMode: Show memory and disks as percentages or exact values
hints.wifi: Show current WiFi signal strength in the network row
hints.sparkline: Show a 60-second trend line next to CPU / memory / network
hints.cpuCores: Show usage for each logical core below the CPU row
hints.diskIo: Append per-second read/write speed to each drive (↓12M/s ↑3M/s)
hints.memSpec: Show memory type and speed below MEM (e.g. DDR4 3200MHz)
hints.compact: Shrink to a single performance row (Ctrl+Alt+M)
hints.visCpuModel: Show the exact CPU model below CPU
hints.visBattery: Hidden automatically on desktops; can be disabled on laptops
hints.resetAll: Reset all preferences (theme, colors, glass, display mode, clock, threshold, optional toggles, hidden rows, compact mode)

options.fontPlaceholder: Enter a font name, e.g. 'JetBrains Mono', monospace

reset.confirm:
Reset all settings to defaults?

This will reset:
• Theme, colors and glass effect
• Display mode, clock format and alert threshold
• Language and all optional toggles (uptime / WiFi / charts, etc.)
• Hidden metric rows and compact mode

Hardware cache and window position are kept.
